text: Managing a team requires several important skills. First, good communication is essential. You need to listen to your team members and share information clearly. Second, delegation means giving tasks to the right people and trusting them to do the work. Third, feedback helps your team improve, so give helpful comments regularly. Motivation is also key; when people feel valued, they work harder. Finally, conflict resolution is necessary because disagreements happen. A good manager solves problems calmly and fairly. By using these skills, you can build a strong team that works well together and achieves its goals.
